sentences.text:
Asish Kumar Behera & Others vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite
Party on 20 April, 2023

Author: V. Narasingh
Bench: V. Narasingh
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Blapl No. 12428 of 2022
 Asish Kumar Behera & Others .... Petitioners
 Mr. M.K. Mishra, Sr. Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Mr. A.K. Nayak, Adv.(OPID)
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Appearance memo filed by Mr. Mishra, learned senior counsel for the petitioners is taken on record.

2. Heard learned senior counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the OPID.
3.

The petitioners are accused in connection with G.R. Case No.14 of 2019, pending before the learned Presiding Officer Designated Court of OPID Berhampur, Ganjam, arising out of Polsara P.S.
Case No.115 of 2016 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 420/409/471/506/34 of the IPC read with Section 4 & 5 of Chit Fund Money Circulation (Banning) Act and Section 6 of OPID Act.

entities.text: Designated Court of OPID Berhampur, Ganjam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Presiding Officer, OPID Court, Berhampur, by order dated 02.12.2022 in the aforementioned case,
the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. It is submitted by the learned senior counsel that one co- accused Bhagaban Palai has since been released on bail by this Court by order dated 12.04.2023 in BLAPL No.12552 of 2022 and the petitioners are similarly placed with the co-accused inasmuch as petitioner Nos.1, 2 & 3 are concerned they are the members of the Krutibibha Credit Cooperative Societies Ltd. and petitioner No.4 is a share holder of the Krutibibha Corporation Ltd.
Asish Kumar Behera & Others vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196116123/

entities.text: Asish Kumar Behera & Others vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 6 . It is the submission of the learned senior counsel that even if the entire case of the prosecution is accepted at its face value, there is nothing on record that the present petitioners were at the helm of the affairs of the two companies i.e. Krutibibha Credit Cooperative Societies Ltd. and Krutibibha Corporation Ltd.
Hence, as admittedly charge sheet has already been filed, further continuance of the petitioners in custody is unwarranted.

7. It is further submitted by the learned senior counsel that the petitioners were not named as accused and in fact they were arrested after a span of six years from the date of registration of the FIR and prima facie are similarly placed with the co-accused, who has since been released as noted above.
8.
Learned counsel for the OPID with his usual fairness does not dispute that in material terms the petitioners are at par with the co-accused so released.
9. Considering the nature of allegations and the release of the co-accused, this Court directs the petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. Additionally, it is directed that the petitioners shall not leave the State of Odisha without express permission of the learned Court in seisin and shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Asish Kumar Behera & Others vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196116123/
